RapidOCR ONNX Runtime 1.4.4 is vendored from its installed PyPI wheel, including
its bundled PaddleOCR models, to use headless OpenCV without pulling a second
GUI OpenCV wheel into the Vercel function. No models are downloaded at scan time.
`rapidocr-manifest.json` records wheel-RECORD-verified SHA-256 hashes for all 24
runtime files. The original source headers and package metadata are retained.
Apache-2.0 license: RapidOCR-LICENSE. Source: https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR
This is OCR model data/software, not Pokémon reference artwork or private photos.
